commits.comment: 为 Gemma4 DSpark 的 adaptive verification 在 FlashInfer 上启用变长 decode CUDA graph（varlen decode graph），并顺势统一“最大 decode query 长度”的计算。核心接口变化：vllm/v1/attention/backend.py 新增模块级 max_decode_query_len(vllm_config)（v2 model runner 下为 1+num_speculative_tokens，v1 且 parallel_drafting 时再各加 num_speculative_tokens），AttentionMetadataBuilder 新增 classmethod get_varlen_cudagraph_max_query_len()（默认 None），并把 _init_reorder_batch_threshold() 中的内联计算替换为 max_decode_query_len()，这意味着 reorder_batch_threshold 在 v2 model runner 下不再为 parallel_drafting 额外加宽。vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py 实现该 bound（仅 TRTLLM_GEN 且非 DCP、uniform gate 通过时返回 max_decode_query_len），decode 的 q_len_per_req 改为 min(max_query_len, reorder_batch_threshold) 上界，并始终传 GPU qo_indptr；split_decodes_and_prefills 的 require_uniform 条件相应放宽。vllm/v1/worker/gpu/attn_utils.py 新增 get_varlen_cudagraph_unsupported_backend()；vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py 在 batch 含 prefill 时把 max_query_len 置 None 以排除 varlen decode graph，并把 adaptive verification 的构造参数 attn_cg_support 移除；vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/adaptive_verification.py 改用新校验函数并在 additional 组上按 support level 判定；cudagraph_utils/dp_utils 更新 max_query_len 语义注释。另外把 MLA index_group、sparse_swa、dcp ops、hisparse runtime、minimax_m3 amd indexer 的内联 max-decode-query 计算统一到新函数；SpeculativeConfig.compute_hash 纳入 dspark 的 enable_adaptive_verification 以隔离图缓存；transformers_utils/config.py 清理 gemma4_text 混入的冗余 rope_parameters 标量；gemma4_dspark.py 支持从 checkpoint 加载 confidence head。风险集中在 reorder_batch_threshold 的语义变更与 varlen decode graph 的 bound/None 语义，任何宣称支持或被要求支持该图的 attention builder 都必须正确实现或返回 None。

affected_interfaces: vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.adaptive_verification.maybe_create_adaptive_verification_manager — the keyword parameter `attn_cg_support` was removed in this commit. vllm-ascend calls it at vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_model_runner.py:82 with `attn_cg_support=attn_cg_support`, which now raises TypeError on every V2 initialize_kv_cache().

vllm.v1.attention.backend.AttentionMetadataBuilder.get_varlen_cudagraph_max_query_len — new classmethod (default returns None). All Ascend metadata builders inherit it: vllm_ascend/attention/{attention_v1,mla_v1,dsa_v1,sfa_v1,indexer}.py, vllm_ascend/attention/context_parallel/dsa_cp.py, vllm_ascend/models/minimax_m3/msa_m3.py, vllm_ascend/ops/gdn_attn_builder.py. Builders that report UNIFORM_BATCH and are used as adaptive-verification targets must now override it with a bound >= 1+num_speculative_tokens.

vllm.v1.worker.gpu.attn_utils.get_varlen_cudagraph_unsupported_backend — new validation helper called by the adaptive verification manager; it replaces the previous reliance on get_attn_cg_support/AttentionCGSupportInfo and now validates `additional_attn_cg_support` unconditionally.

vllm.v1.attention.backend.max_decode_query_len — new shared helper replacing duplicated 1 + (2 if parallel_drafting else 1)*N logic. Ascend builders currently hardcode their own decode_threshold (e.g. vllm_ascend/attention/attention_v1.py:243-253, mla_v1.py:295-305) and can adopt it for consistency.

AttentionMetadataBuilder._init_reorder_batch_threshold — behavior change for Model Runner V2 + parallel_drafting: threshold is now 1+num_speculative_tokens instead of 1+2*num_speculative_tokens. Impacts Ascend callers: vllm_ascend/models/minimax_m3/msa_m3.py:255 and :781, and vllm_ascend/ops/gdn_attn_builder.py:374-394.
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) In vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_model_runner.py remove the `attn_cg_support=attn_cg_support` argument from the `upstream.maybe_create_adaptive_verification_manager(...)` call (line 82), matching the new upstream signature in vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py. Keep computing `attn_cg_support` (lines 75-76) because it is still consumed by `resolve_cudagraph_mode_and_sizes` (lines 134-144). 2) Decide whether Ascend target builders want to support adaptive verification on non-ALWAYS cudagraphs: if so, add a `get_varlen_cudagraph_max_query_len(vllm_config, kv_cache_spec) -> int` classmethod to the relevant Ascend builders (mla_v1.AscendMLAMetadataBuilder, etc.). Otherwise no change is needed because Ascend DSA/SFA/indexer already return AttentionCGSupport.ALWAYS when enable_adaptive_verification is set (vllm_ascend/attention/dsa_v1.py:736, sfa_v1.py:559, indexer.py:612). 3) Confirm AscendModelState.get_additional_cg_support still yields (ALWAYS, None); the new unconditional additional-support validation only passes when it is ALWAYS, so any Ascend override returning UNIFORM_BATCH would now fail manager creation. 4) Re-verify decode/prefill splitting and graph capture for models using `_init_reorder_batch_threshold(..., supports_spec_as_decode=True)` with parallel_drafting (MiniMax-M3 msa_m3 builders, GDN attention builder) since the V2 reorder threshold narrows from 1+2N to 1+N. No adaptation is required for vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py, gemma4_dspark.py, transformers_utils/config.py gemma4 rope handling, minimax_m3/amd/indexer_aiter.py, dcp.py or hisparse/runtime.py (CUDA-only or no Ascend counterpart).
deep_analysis.risk: High-severity but trivial-to-fix: the removed `attn_cg_support` kwarg is passed to maybe_create_adaptive_verification_manager on every V2 path, so vllm-ascend's GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache raises TypeError at engine/model-runner startup for all V2 models (not just adaptive verification). After removing the arg, verify the new varlen-cudagraph bound validation still passes for Ascend targets: any Ascend builder reporting UNIFORM_BATCH (mla_v1, msa_m3, gdn) whose new `get_varlen_cudagraph_max_query_len` returns the default None will be rejected under adaptive verification, whereas the old code also rejected non-ALWAYS builders — so the main regression risk is behavioral (reorder threshold 1+N vs 1+2N on V2) rather than an interface break. Run the Ascend UT suites tests/ut/worker/test_adaptive_verification.py, test_model_runner_v2_kv_cache.py and test_gdn_attn_builder.py plus the DSpark/Gemma4 e2e tests after adapting.

commits.comment: Bugfix：让 BERT 系模型的 pooling head 在「raw logits / 关闭 output activation」场景下仍保留模型自身的头部层。BertPooler 与 ModernBertPooler 原先把模型 head 拆成 `projector=self.dense` 和 `activation=LambdaPoolerActivation(...)` 两段传给 EmbeddingPoolerHead；当运行时不启用 output activation 时，activation 那段会被丢掉，等于返回未过 tanh（BERT）/未过 norm+act（ModernBERT）的 dense 输出。现在把激活折叠进 projector lambda（`self.act_fn(self.dense(x))` / `self.norm(self.act(self.dense(x)))`），并删除 LambdaPoolerActivation 导入，使 head 层无论 activation 是否启用都被保留。属于共享模型实现的输出语义变更，会影响所有平台上 BERT/ModernBERT embedding 任务的结果。

commits.comment: 修复 memory profiling 期间因 allocator 碎片导致可用 KV cache 被错误缩小的问题。定位：Worker.determine_available_memory 中 profile_run 会让 workspace（如 MoE workspace）逐步增长并释放旧的大 buffer，随后的小分配可能从刚释放的 GiB 级 segment 中切分出来，把整个 segment 钉住，使其在 memory_profiling 的 empty_cache() 之后仍被计入已用内存，从而从 KV cache 预算中被扣掉。修复：(1) 把 profile_run 包在 _scoped_allocator_max_split(max_split_size_mb=20) 中，超过阈值的 block 不再被切分从而保持可释放，并且该 context 在 memory_profiling 测量前退出、恢复原设置；(2) 该 contextmanager 的适用条件从 current_platform.is_cuda() 放宽为 is_cuda_alike() 且 allocator backend 为 native，cudaMallocAsync 等异步 allocator 直接 no-op；(3) 设置保存/恢复改为读取 _accelerator_getAllocatorSettings()（不存在时回退 torch.cuda.memory._snapshot()['allocator_settings']['PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF']），并原样恢复整个设置串——修正了旧实现只解析恢复 max_split_size_mb、会丢掉 garbage_collection_threshold / roundup_power2_divisions / max_non_split_rounding_mb 等选项且默认值写成 SIZE_MAX 的缺陷。测试新增 3 个用例：新进程验证 scoped 限制确实让大块可释放、参数化验证成功/异常路径与非规范分隔符下设置完整恢复、以及异步 allocator 被跳过。风险：位于 KV cache 容量估算的关键路径，恢复逻辑若有偏差会污染后续分配行为（测试覆盖了失败路径）。

commits.comment: 重构日志的进程装饰机制以兼容 JSON 日志。此前 decorate_logs 通过 monkey-patch sys.stdout/stderr 的 write 注入彩色/纯文本前缀，任何以 JSON 输出的日志都会被前缀破坏（每条记录不再是合法 JSON）。本次改为在 _configure_vllm_root_logger 中注册 logging.setLogRecordFactory(_vllm_log_record_factory)，为每条 LogRecord 注入 vllm_process_name（由 set_vllm_process_name 设置，按 pid 校验，跨 fork 时回退到 record.processName）；默认 _FORMAT 改为包含 (%(vllm_process_name)s pid=%(process)d)，ColoredFormatter 对该前缀着色并新增 PROCESS_PREFIX_COLOR/RESET；decorate_logs 相应简化为调用 set_vllm_process_name(skip_if_set=...)，删除 _add_prefix 与 CYAN/RESET 常量。文档补充了 JSON 日志的 formatter format 示例，以及边界说明：不修改 stdout/stderr、第三方直写 stdout 的内容无法被 JSON 化、uvicorn 日志需单独配置。风险：setLogRecordFactory 是全局的，会影响所有 logger（含第三方库）；不再修改 stdout 意味着依赖 stdout 文本前缀做日志解析/排障的外部脚本会失效；_add_prefix 属内部 API 移除。
